example_sentences_in_bangla: দুই গ্রামের লোকজনের মধ্যে লাঠালাঠি লেগে গেছে।
example_sentences_in_english: A fierce fight has broken out between the villagers.
The police arrived due to the brawl in the neighborhood.
note: This idiom evokes images of traditional rural disputes in Bengal where physical confrontations with sticks were common.
